name: Portage County, WI
findings: Portage County has 222 nonprofit organizations. 102 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Portage County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Portage County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
